description: Change console language, time zone and notification switches. Low-balance alerts use fixed tiers ($100, $50, $10, $5, $1, one email the first time the balance drops below each) and can only be turned on or off. Security notifications can be turned on here but only turned off in the console. Needs the settings:write account scope, which is off by default and can only be granted by the account owner in the console.
name: everyinfra_settings_update
title: Update account settings
